title: i tried high ticket sales and made $100k in 90 days (here’s the truth)
summary: A young closer says remote high-ticket sales for influencer coaching offers made him $100K in 90 days; the key is landing an offer with strong lead flow.

verdicts.note: Commission closers depend on an offer's lead flow and most quit within weeks; large quick earnings come from the few placed on top influencer offers.
